who.label: Who
who.rule: Say who the people are and how you know them. For follow-ups, include where you met and their company when the source gives them.

why_now.label: Why now
why_now.rule: Explain why this needs attention now, including any source-backed deadline.

cost.label: Cost
cost.rule: State what saying yes costs in money or time. Say when the source leaves the cost unknown.

risk.label: Risk
risk.rule: State what could go wrong and whether the choice can be undone, using only source facts.

draft.label: The draft
draft.rule: Make the exact draft easy to open before deciding. State who receives it and whether yes sends it or only saves a task.

too_long.label: Too long
too_long.rule: Shorten the card's context to the facts needed for this choice; keep the full explanation in Details.
